name: Extended Patch Isosurface Extraction for Node-Centered Data
definition: An isosurface extraction approach for node-centered AMR data that preserves original patch structure and cell identity by extending refined patches and decomposing coarse cells at boundaries.
summary: Extended Patch Isosurface Extraction generates crack-free isosurfaces from node-centered AMR data by decomposing boundary cells into pyramids while preserving patch identity.
